rows.label: Record a development capture of this session, which costs disk and log
Record mission history
rows.description: Lets the Flight History panel record the live stream as a replayable mission. It captures only the topics the dashboard already carries, so it is cheap to leave on.

rows.label: Record every telemetry topic
rows.description: While recording, subscribes to every telemetry topic rather than only what the dashboard has open, so a replay can show any widget's history. Raises the mod's load and the recording's size. Has no effect while mission history is off.

rows.label: Record camera video with missions
rows.description: Reserved for capturing the connected camera feed alongside telemetry. Nothing records video yet. Has no effect while mission history is off.

rows.label: Sound effects
rows.description: Plays the alarm chime, the launch countdown tones and the abort alert on the main screen. Station screens are always silent.

rows.label: Serve camera feeds wherever Gonogo is reachable
rows.description: Kerbcast listens on every address of this computer, as Gonogo does, so Gonogo on another device can show the camera feeds. Off, only this computer can. Turning it on replaces an address you set by hand in Kerbcast's settings. Anyone on your network who can reach this computer can watch the feeds: Kerbcast has no sign-in. Takes effect at the first flight after KSP starts; if you have flown since, restart KSP.
